name: Fix it for me
description: Tell the Agent what is wrong, like "the site is slow". It looks at your web servers, explains what it found, and asks before it changes anything.

nodes.goal:
{{input.problem}}

Look at the servers first: load, memory, disk, the web server and app logs. Find the cause. Then fix it if a small, safe change does it, and check that it worked. Explain what you found and what you changed.
